name: Rotary Phone
desc: Vintage rotary telephone that periodically bursts into ringing — hopping and shaking with bell-wave arcs radiating off the handset — between calm rests; the finger-hole dial winds and springs back, the curly cord ripples, and the handset bounces in its cradle. Styles: cherry red, black bakelite, mint-green kitchen, mustard 70s, and a translucent ghost-phone.

ringing.doc: ring burst intensity (0 = silent still phone)
